topography.project_purpose: Bundie is a yield aggregator that optimizes user deposits across multiple DeFi protocols. It uses smart accounts and routers to automate yield strategies, managing assets and executing transactions on behalf of users.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol consists of a single product family where AccountManager contracts govern user accounts and RouterManager contracts execute transactions. They share infrastructure through a common deployer and proxy patterns, with Relayer implementations handling cross-chain or off-chain interactions.
